adaptation.source_state_adaptation: The source fifth coordinate is clock time; the stage grid represents it explicitly, leaving four physical plant state coordinates.
adaptation.initial_quantifier: universal over the two listed states
adaptation.disturbance_semantics: adversarial, independently selected from the finite catalogue at each stage; it is player 2 control in the source game
adaptation.sensor: before each decision, observe position_1-position_2 plus error in {-0.2,+0.2}; no velocity is observed
adaptation.measurement_error_semantics: independent stage-wise finite catalogue, fixed for each authored row
adaptation.information_pattern: controller sees the complete ordered noisy relative-position history before choosing u; v is selected after u and before the next observation
adaptation.state_quantization: none; propagate the source RK4 map without state rounding
adaptation.sensor_quantization: none; the CSL replay API represents the declared additive measurement channel as an affine observation map

estimator.name: finite-prior full-history constrained least squares
estimator.prior: the two listed initial states with equal zero prior cost
estimator.process_history: enumerate every past disturbance-catalogue sequence consistent with the known applied controls
estimator.residual_constraint: each observation residual must lie in [-0.25,+0.25] for the bounded additive sensor-error catalogue
estimator.tie_break: lexicographic initial-state row, then lexicographic disturbance-index sequence
estimator.guarantee: finite-catalogue state hypothesis only; no continuous or statistical estimation guarantee

controllers.certainty_equivalent: at each observation history, use the MHE state hypothesis as a singleton initial set and solve finite-action minimax over future v sequences; execute the first u and replan
controllers.set_based_robust: at each observation history, use all current states from compatible finite rows as a V-set, solve finite-action minimax over future v sequences; execute the first u and replan
controllers.causal_reference: complete finite observation-history minimax dynamic program over the same initial, disturbance, noise, and action catalogues

limits: The experiment is an explicit finite noisy-observation adaptation of the source RL environment, not a reproduction of its continuous-action training or return.
The set-based receding planner is robust to its current posterior finite catalogue for each open-loop lookahead; only the separate causal reference branches on future observations.
All reported universal outcomes cover only the authored finite catalogues and listed initial states.
